## Page pg1

The New Home Leopard Greenhand Chapter Conducting team, Public Relations team, and Ag Advocacy team got second place at the district competition. Therefore, all teams made it to state.

Greenhand Chapter Conducting- An[FFA Leadership Development Event](https://www.google.com/search?q=FFA+Leadership+Development+Event&rlz=1CAKLUN_enUS1021&oq=what+is+Greenhand+Chapter+Conducting&gs_lcrp=EgZjaHJvbWUyBggAEEUYOTINCAEQABiGAxiABBiKBTINCAIQABiGAxiABBiKBTINCAMQABiGAxiABBiKBTINCAQQABiGAxiABBiKBTIKCAUQABiABBiiBDIKCAYQABiiBBiJBTIKCAcQABiABBiiBDIHCAgQABjvBdIBCDI0MTdqMGo3qAIAsAIA&sourceid=chrome&ie=UTF-8&safe=active&ssui=on&mstk=AUtExfCfLlFmPEjFQUOgPrADuyXiNqH4fV1IsqroEB21fCbGa6_gjhiEDHd0jhjzGpuV5uwLFpDptIORsltqpiNa3TzEMaEKvqizPXQy490SCJEk_zwsr1RSaEXtH78LSdcAVQc&csui=3&ved=2ahUKEwjH0pz2l7ORAxUUm2oFHX9GOuAQgK4QegQIARAC)where first year members demonstrate their knowledge of[parliamentary procedure](https://www.google.com/search?q=parliamentary+procedure&rlz=1CAKLUN_enUS1021&oq=what+is+Greenhand+Chapter+Conducting&gs_lcrp=EgZjaHJvbWUyBggAEEUYOTINCAEQABiGAxiABBiKBTINCAIQABiGAxiABBiKBTINCAMQABiGAxiABBiKBTINCAQQABiGAxiABBiKBTIKCAUQABiABBiiBDIKCAYQABiiBBiJBTIKCAcQABiABBiiBDIHCAgQABjvBdIBCDI0MTdqMGo3qAIAsAIA&sourceid=chrome&ie=UTF-8&safe=active&ssui=on&mstk=AUtExfCfLlFmPEjFQUOgPrADuyXiNqH4fV1IsqroEB21fCbGa6_gjhiEDHd0jhjzGpuV5uwLFpDptIORsltqpiNa3TzEMaEKvqizPXQy490SCJEk_zwsr1RSaEXtH78LSdcAVQc&csui=3&ved=2ahUKEwjH0pz2l7ORAxUUm2oFHX9GOuAQgK4QegQIARAD)by running a mock chapter meeting with teams often quizzed on rules afterward.

The team consisted of Leland Mcdonald, Wyatt Stiggins, Cohen Thero, Cooper Derington, Kyson Brookshire, Waylon Epley, Kameron Edwards, Laney Teeter.

Public relations-Public relations involvespromoting the organization and its agricultural activities to the public through various communication channels.

The team consists of Locklynn Mounce, Kynlie Schilling, Makinlee Brookshire, and Kaden Mcdonald.

Ag Advocacy-promoting the agriculture industry by educating the public and leaders on its importance, value, and practices, using skills like public speaking, research, and community engagement to build trust, address misconceptions, and support agricultural policies.

The team consists of Kirklyn Fulton, Mason Walker, Kenny Donald, and Kale Tabor.

The public relations team made it to the semi finals, and ended up getting fifth place overall. Congratulations to FFA for making it to state!

The New Home Leopard Greenhand Chapter Conducting team, Public Relations team, and Ag Advocacy team got second place at the district competition. Therefore, all teams made it to state.  


Greenhand Chapter Conducting- An FFA Leadership Development Event where first year members demonstrate their knowledge of parliamentary procedure by running a mock chapter meeting with teams often quizzed on rules afterward. 

The team consisted of Leland Mcdonald, Wyatt Stiggins, Cohen Thero, Cooper Derington, Kyson Brookshire, Waylon Epley, Kameron Edwards, Laney Teeter.


Public relations- Public relations involves promoting the organization and its agricultural activities to the public through various communication channels. 

The team consists of Locklynn Mounce, Kynlie Schilling, Makinlee Brookshire, and Kaden Mcdonald.


Ag Advocacy- promoting the agriculture industry by educating the public and leaders on its importance, value, and practices, using skills like public speaking, research, and community engagement to build trust, address misconceptions, and support agricultural policies.

The team consists of Kirklyn Fulton, Mason Walker, Kenny Donald, and Kale Tabor. 


The public relations team made it to the semi finals, and ended up getting fifth place overall. Congratulations to FFA for making it to state!
